title: Implement active-voice and imperative-procedure checks
description: Add heuristics detecting passive voice and non-imperative procedure steps, reusing and extending the passive-voice regex approach already present in editorial_diagnosis.py.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented asd_passive_voice (be-verb + participle pattern) and asd_non_imperative_step (subject-opener heuristic, procedure mode only). Verified via behave scenarios and tests/test_asd_ste100_writing_rules.py.
